versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02083 If ComRetryFailedTransmitRequests is set to false and an I-PDU with ComTx- ModeMode DIRECT or MIXED and ComTxModeNumberOfRepetitions set to 0 is triggered for sending, the AUTOSAR COM module shall invoke PduR_ComTransmit for this I-PDU just once, independently of the result of the confirmation.
